props.label: Posted notice
props.text: Walk up and press Space to read this. Space is also how you talk to people.

props.label: Sticky note
props.text: Check the case file before you lie. Barry will agree to almost anything that gets him out by five.

props.label: Closing-time sign
props.text: Closes at 5:00. The courier has to come before lock-up.

props.label: Swiftbag pickup card
props.text: Swiftbag Couriers picks up the cash bag at closing. The fee is about 0.50 to 1 dollar, paid on the spot.

props.label: Note on the counter
props.text: Barry watches the clock like it owes him money. He cannot leave until Swiftbag has been.
